title: Names Nina for tips, then refuses Marcus's sit-in offer and says handle it yourself (gave in)
goal: Part 1: do NOT agree to stay late. Ask why the same customers keep calling in again; after the woman's story say only 'I see. Thanks for walking me through that.' Part 2: give a clear change plus reason: 'Her note only said can't log in, but she'd told you more. Please write down what customers say they've already tried, so they don't have to call again.' Hold it if he says 'even at lunch?'. Part 3: when Marcus raises the upset customers say only 'Ask Nina for some tips on angry customers.' When he asks 'Like, just ask her what to say?' say 'Yes, just ask her.' When Marcus then offers 'Maybe Nina could sit in on them with me. Would that be okay?' DISAGREE: first ask one detail ('Isn't she busy?') then refuse: 'No, she's got her own calls. Just handle them yourself.'
must_hit: Clear change to the note plus reason
must_avoid: Proposing the calls with Nina yourself

intents.when: Marcus says the same customers keep calling in again and he'll stay late
examples: Why do you think they keep calling in again?
I see. Thanks for walking me through that.

intents.when: Marcus raises short calls and the tech team idea
examples: Her note only said can't log in, but she'd told you more. Please write down what customers say they've already tried, so they don't have to call again.
Yes, it saves the repeat calls.
Ask Nina for some tips on angry customers.

intents.when: Marcus asks like just ask her what to say
Marcus offers that Nina sit in with him
intents.do: Disagree: one detail question, then refuse
examples: No, she's got her own calls. Just handle them yourself.
